cues.en: Mike: The first specific variant of the t-test that we will focus on is called the one-sample t-test.
cues.zh: Mike：第一個要專注的 t 檢定變形，叫單一樣本 t 檢定。

cues.en: And this is a good one to start with because it has the simplest formula and kind of the simplest setup, so it's the easiest one to learn about.
cues.zh: 很適合從這裡開始，因為公式和設定最簡單，最容易學。

cues.en: So one-sample here, this prefix, one-sample, refers to the fact that this variant of the t-test is for when you have one sample.
cues.zh: 這裡「單一樣本」表示，這個 t 檢定版本用於只有一個樣本的情況。

cues.en: So let's see what the purpose of the one-sample t-test is.
cues.zh: 看看用途。

cues.en: It's when you test whether a set of numbers could've been drawn from a distribution with a specific mean.
cues.zh: 檢驗一組數字，是否可能從具有特定平均值的分布抽出。

cues.en: So in this case, we're not comparing two different groups, we're comparing only one group, and we wanna know whether the mean of that group
cues.zh: 不比較兩個群組，只比較一組，想知道這組平均值，

cues.en: could be drawn from a distribution with a specified mean.
cues.zh: 是否可能來自具有指定平均值的分布。

cues.en: It might be that that mean is 0, or 58.3, or whatever is the relevant test of the mean.
cues.zh: 那個平均值可能是 0、58.3，或任何相關檢驗值。

cues.en: Okay, so here's an example.
cues.zh: 這裡有個例子。

cues.en: Let's say we have a group of students, and we wanna test whether the IQ of that group of students is significantly different from 100.
cues.zh: 一群學生，想檢驗他們的 IQ 是否顯著不同於 100。

cues.en: Now, you might know that, first of all, IQ doesn't exactly measure intelligence.
cues.zh: 首先，你可能知道，IQ 並不完全測量智力。

cues.en: IQ measures the thing that the IQ test measures.
cues.zh: IQ 測量的是 IQ 測驗所測的事物。

cues.en: But it's designed, the IQ test is designed, and it's actually changed every year a little bit, so that the average IQ in a population is 100.
cues.zh: 但測驗的設計，其實每年會稍微調整，讓母體平均 IQ 為 100。

cues.en: So if a group of students has an IQ that's around 100, it means that that group of students is drawn from a sample
cues.zh: 所以這群學生 IQ 在 100 附近，表示他們是來自

cues.en: of a sort of a regular, unbiased sample from the population with average intelligence.
cues.zh: 母體的一個普通、無偏、平均智力的樣本。

cues.en: Conversely, if the IQ of this group of students was significantly different from 100, then that group of students is either significantly more intelligent than the population
cues.zh: 相反地，如果顯著不同於 100，當 IQ 高於 100，這群就顯著比母體更聰明，

cues.en: if the IQ scores are above 100, or not quite so smart if their IQs are less than 100.
cues.zh: 低於 100，則沒那麼聰明。

cues.en: But it's okay, I'm sure they're still really good kids who are nice and, you know, blah, blah, blah.
cues.zh: 但沒關係，相信仍然是很好的孩子，人很好等等。

cues.en: Okay, so this is kind of how you would explain it a little bit colloquially.
cues.zh: 這算是日常語言的說法。

cues.en: A slightly more formal statement would be to say, estimate the probability that a certain group of students has an average IQ of 100.
cues.zh: 稍微正式一點，是估計某群學生平均 IQ 為 100 的機率。

cues.en: Notice, that's a little bit different from what we're saying here.
cues.zh: 注意，這和這裡說的稍有不同。

cues.en: Here we're saying whether the IQ of this group is different from 100.
cues.zh: 這裡在說，這組 IQ 是否不同於 100。

cues.en: That's kind of, you know, what you think about, why you're doing this research.
cues.zh: 這是做研究時思考的問題。

cues.en: This is probably how you would explain it to other people.
cues.zh: 也可能是向別人解釋的方式。

cues.en: But the more formal statistical statement is that we are estimating the probability of the null hypothesis.
cues.zh: 但更正式的統計說法，是估計虛無假設的機率。

cues.en: So we're estimating the probability that this group of students has an average IQ of whatever is their empirical average IQ,
cues.zh: 估計這群學生的平均 IQ，等於其實驗平均 IQ 的機率，

cues.en: given that the null hypothesis actually is an IQ of 100.
cues.zh: 條件是，虛無假設的 IQ 確實為 100。

cues.en: Okay, so this is just one example application of how you would use the one-sample t-test.
cues.zh: 這只是單一樣本 t 檢定的一個應用例子。

cues.en: Again, the important part here is that we don't have two groups of students, or multiple groups of students.
cues.zh: 重點是，不是兩群或多群學生。

cues.en: We're not measuring the same group of students before and after taking some crazy drug that is supposed to make people smarter, which never works in real life.
cues.zh: 不是對同群學生，在服用某種聲稱讓人更聰明的瘋狂藥物前後測量，這在真實生活從來無效。

cues.en: It only works in movies and books and things like that.
cues.zh: 只在電影、書本等裡面有效。

cues.en: So we just have one group, and we do a one-shot experiment.
cues.zh: 只有一組，做一次實驗。

cues.en: That's it. That's the one sample that we have.
cues.zh: 就這樣，這就是唯一的樣本。

cues.en: Okay, so here's the formula.
cues.zh: 這裡是公式。

cues.en: You can see that it looks an awful lot like the formula I showed in the previous video.
cues.zh: 看起來和前一部影片的公式非常像。

cues.en: So we have the t-value with n-1 degrees of freedom is equal to this formula here, this ratio.
cues.zh: 具有 n−1 個自由度的 t 值，等於這個公式、這個比值。

cues.en: So the numerator is the empirical mean, so the observed mean of our group of students, minus mu.
cues.zh: 分子是實驗平均，也就是學生的觀察平均值，減去 μ。

cues.en: And here I'm saying mu because we subtract away whatever is the null hypothesis population parameter that we are testing against.
cues.zh: 用 μ，是因為減去的是要檢驗的虛無假設母體參數。

cues.en: So here we see all of these terms written out.
cues.zh: 這裡列出所有項目。

cues.en: So the sample mean, the null hypothesis value, sample standard deviation, so this would be the standard deviation of IQ tests or IQ scores across this group of students,
cues.zh: 樣本平均、虛無假設值、樣本標準差，也就是這群學生 IQ 測驗分數的標準差，

cues.en: and the number of data points.
cues.zh: 以及資料點數。

cues.en: And then we have n-1 degrees of freedom in this t-test, And that's because we are testing for the mean.
cues.zh: 這個 t 檢定有 n−1 個自由度，因為檢驗的是平均值。

cues.en: And as you know, the mean of a sample, once we compute it, we have n-1 degrees of freedom.
cues.zh: 你知道，一旦計算樣本平均值，就有 n−1 個自由度。

cues.en: Now, I specified that, in the previous slide, that this mu value here is gonna be 100, but that's just the number that I came up with
cues.zh: 上一張指定 μ=100，但只是為那個特定檢驗

cues.en: for that particular test.
cues.zh: 選的數字。

cues.en: You can imagine, for this example, you can imagine that we have a group of students whose parents think that their kids are super smart, much smarter than the average.
cues.zh: 也可以想像，這群學生的父母認為孩子超級聰明，比平均聰明很多。

cues.en: Now, that's not surprising.
cues.zh: 這不意外。

cues.en: Parents always think that their kids are better than average.
cues.zh: 父母總認為自己的孩子優於平均。

cues.en: So we could get this group of kids together and test for mu equals 120, and then, if we found that their average is less than 120,
cues.zh: 可以找這群孩子，檢驗 μ=120；若發現平均值低於 120，

cues.en: we might find evidence that these kids are not quite as smart as their parents think they are.
cues.zh: 可能取得證據，顯示孩子沒有父母想得那麼聰明。

cues.en: So there are several assumptions that underlie the one-sample t-test.
cues.zh: 單一樣本 t 檢定有幾個基本假設。

cues.en: And actually, I have to say, looking through these quickly, I think these are assumptions also of two-sample t-tests, but I'll go through these as well anyway.
cues.zh: 其實快速看過，這些也應該是雙樣本 t 檢定的假設，不過仍逐一說明。

cues.en: So we assume that the data are numeric.
cues.zh: 假設資料是數值。

cues.en: This one-sample t-test is not the appropriate test statistic for categorical data.
cues.zh: 單一樣本 t 檢定不適用於類別資料。

cues.en: We use other statistics for categorical data.
cues.zh: 類別資料使用其他統計方法。

cues.en: So the data for a t-test should be numeric.
cues.zh: 所以 t 檢定資料應為數值。

cues.en: They're ideally interval or ratio scale.
cues.zh: 理想上是區間或比率尺度。

cues.en: And you know, if you have discrete data, then it's probably okay.
cues.zh: 如果是離散資料，大概也可以。

cues.en: In most cases it should be okay to run a t-test with discrete data.
cues.zh: 大部分情況，對離散資料做 t 檢定應該沒問題。

cues.en: You're gonna lose a little bit of precision,
cues.zh: 會損失一點精度，

cues.en: but it should be okay, as long as there's enough values in there.
cues.zh: 但只要有足夠多數值，應該可以。

cues.en: Okay, a big assumption is that the data are independent from each other.
cues.zh: 重要假設是，資料彼此獨立。

cues.en: So we don't wanna have dependencies in the sample.
cues.zh: 不希望樣本中有相依關係。

cues.en: And that's also related to assumption three, which is that the data are randomly drawn from the population to which the generalization should be made.
cues.zh: 這也和第三個假設有關：資料從要推廣到的母體中隨機抽取。

cues.en: So when we test this group of students to see if their IQ is significantly different from 100, what is the population that we want to generalize back to?
cues.zh: 檢驗這群學生 IQ 是否顯著不同於 100，要推廣到什麼母體？

cues.en: Is it a population of people from a certain socioeconomic background, or who live in a certain geographical area?
cues.zh: 某種社經背景的人，或住在特定地區的人？

cues.en: Obviously, in this particular example that I explained here, we actually don't want to generalize to all students in general, because, you know, the population of all the students
cues.zh: 顯然，在這個特定例子中，不想推廣到所有學生，因為全部學生的母體，

cues.en: should have an average IQ of 100.
cues.zh: 平均 IQ 應該是 100。

cues.en: That's kind of how the IQ is designed.
cues.zh: 這算是 IQ 的設計方式。

cues.en: So population doesn't necessarily mean every single individual.
cues.zh: 所以母體不一定表示每個人。

cues.en: Maybe it's the population of students whose parents are, I don't know, university professors.
cues.zh: 也許是父母為大學教授的學生母體，我不知道。

cues.en: Okay, anyway, and then the fourth assumption is that the mean and standard deviation are valid, appropriate descriptions of the central tendency and the dispersion of the population
cues.zh: 第四個假設是，平均值和標準差，能有效、適當地描述資料來源母體的集中趨勢，

cues.en: from which these data were drawn.
cues.zh: 以及離散程度。

cues.en: What does that mean?
cues.zh: 什麼意思？

cues.en: That means that we assume that the data are approximately normally distributed.
cues.zh: 假設資料大致呈常態分布。

cues.en: They don't have to be perfectly, exactly Gaussian distributed, but as long as there is some clustering in the center and some decrease
cues.zh: 不必完美、精確呈高斯，只要中央有某種聚集，往兩側時

cues.en: in frequency in counts as we get out to the sides, then the t-test is a valid measure.
cues.zh: 頻率、次數減少，t 檢定就是有效量值。

cues.en: All right, so in this video, I explained the one-sample t-test.
cues.zh: 這部影片解釋了單一樣本 t 檢定。

cues.en: This is a great way to start learning about the t-test.
cues.zh: 是開始學 t 檢定很好的方式。

cues.en: I showed you the formula, and I gave an example of where you might use it, and I talked about the assumptions underlying the one-sample t-test.
cues.zh: 展示公式、舉一個使用例子，也談了基本假設。
